title: Story premise EDU120: The Lever’s Balance Point Moves
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: Can the lighter block win by standing farther away? Takeaway/theme: Lever balance depends on both force and perpendicular distance from the pivot.
description: Two toy weights want to balance on a beam, but equal distances fail when one weight is twice as large. Sliding the smaller weight farther from the pivot produces equal opposing idealized moments.
